security_audit.summary: All static findings appear to be documentation false positives. content.value_statement: Tamagui teams can lose compiler benefits when patterns mix inline styles, tokens, and platform logic. This skill gives practical v1.x guidance for stable components, forms, overlays, themes, and animation patterns.
actual_capabilities: Explains Tamagui config v4 setup and project import choices.
Guides compiler-friendly styling with variants, styled components, and prop order rules.
Provides patterns for forms, validation, labels, dialogs, sheets, selects, popovers, and tooltips.
Documents token, theme, typography, and palette decisions for cross-platform design systems.
Summarizes animation driver choices and transition patterns for web and native targets.
Points users to current Tamagui documentation when network access is allowed.
limitations: It provides guidance only; it does not automatically edit or validate a repository.
The guidance targets Tamagui v1.x and may need review for future major versions.
It assumes the project already uses Tamagui or plans to adopt it.
Current documentation checks require explicit network access or user-provided docs.

use_cases.title: Start a Tamagui Project
use_cases.description: Choose config v4 defaults, package imports, shorthands, and token conventions before building shared components.

use_cases.title: Improve Existing Components
use_cases.description: Refactor inline styles, dynamic props, and platform branches into compiler-friendly Tamagui patterns.

use_cases.title: Standardize Product UI
use_cases.description: Create consistent themes, typography, overlays, forms, and animation rules across web and native surfaces.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Tamagui Config
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline a Tamagui config v4 setup for a new React Native and web project. Include import choices, style compatibility, and token setup.

prompt_templates.title: Review Component Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Tamagui component for compiler optimization. Identify inline styles, dynamic values, prop order problems, and variant opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Design Cross-Platform Overlays
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Tamagui dialog, sheet, select, or popover flow for web and touch devices. Include accessibility, Adapt usage, and dismissal behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Design System
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit our Tamagui design system decisions. Check tokens, themes, typography, animation drivers, component wrappers, and form patterns for long-term consistency.

output_examples.input: A developer asks why a Tamagui component loses compiler optimization.
output_examples.output: The response identifies dynamic styling, recommends variants, explains prop order, and names the affected component responsibilities.

output_examples.input: A team needs a mobile-friendly confirmation dialog.
output: Use Dialog for the semantic interaction and Adapt to switch to Sheet on touch screens.
Keep confirm and cancel actions explicit, with accessible labels and predictable dismissal rules.
Use Tamagui tokens for spacing, color, and z-index instead of platform-specific branches.

output_examples.input: A project has Tamagui forms without validation guidance.
output: Recommend external validation with react-hook-form and zod.
Ensure labels and inputs share matching identifiers.
Track submitting, error, and success states with explicit form state.

best_practices: Use styled variants for reusable state and layout changes that the Tamagui compiler can optimize.
Keep imports consistent across a project so components share the same Tamagui package assumptions.
Use Adapt for platform-specific overlay behavior instead of direct platform checks.
anti_patterns: Do not mix React Native StyleSheet values with Tamagui token-driven components.
Do not rely on variable inline style objects for values that should be variants.
Do not assume Tamagui Form validates input without an external validation library.

faq.question: Which Tamagui version does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Tamagui v1.x patterns, including config v4 and current compiler optimization guidance.

faq.question: Can this skill change my code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides review guidance and implementation patterns that an agent or developer can apply.

faq.question: Does it cover React Native and web?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on cross-platform Tamagui choices for web, native, and touch-friendly interfaces.

faq.question: Does it include form validation patterns?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends pairing Tamagui forms with external validation tools such as zod and react-hook-form.

faq.question: Why does it mention compiler optimization?
faq.answer: Tamagui performance depends on patterns the compiler can flatten, such as static variants and stable component props.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No. It includes optional public documentation URLs for cases where the user allows checking current Tamagui docs.
